candidates.description: Common Thai syllable prefixes, grammatical particles, and connective words used in text tokenization.
This vector represents Thai script characters and sub-word tokens containing the Thai letter 'ส' (So Suea).
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ต' (to) and common Thai words or sub-word tokens beginning with or containing it.
Common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and structural word fragments.
This feature vector represents characters and common subword combinations centered around the Thai consonant 'ว' (Vo).
This vector represents common Thai script characters and sub-word tokens used in Thai text processing.
This feature vector activates on various Thai words, prefixes, and fragments frequently found in Thai text.
This vector represents the Thai script character 'อ' (O Ang) and its various combinations with vowels, tone marks, and other letters.
This vector activates on common Thai noun prefixes, morphemes, and linguistic components.
The tokens represent fragments of the Thai script used in multilingual subword tokenization.
